mapper.select:
SELECT po.po_id, po.po_no, DATE_FORMAT(po.request_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS request_date, po.status, ho.hq_outbound_no AS hqOutboundNo, hod.hq_outbound_detail_id AS hq_outbound_detail_id,
ws.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit, mg.group_name,
COALESCE(pod.requested_qty, 0) AS requested_qty, hod.qty AS outboundQty, DATE_FORMAT(ho.shipped_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS outboundAt,
hod.stock_no, DATE_FORMAT(ws.expiry_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expiry_date, NULL AS branch_stock_code
FROM place_order po
JOIN hq_outbound ho ON ho.po_no = po.po_no AND ho.branch_code = po.branch_code
JOIN hq_outbound_detail hod ON ho.hq_outbound_no = hod.hq_outbound_no
JOIN warehouse_stock ws ON hod.stock_no = ws.stock_no
LEFT JOIN place_order_detail pod ON po.po_id = pod.po_id AND pod.material_code = ws.material_code
JOIN material m ON ws.material_code = m.material_code
JOIN material_group mg ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id
LEFT JOIN branch_stock_inbound bi ON bi.hq_outbound_no = ho.hq_outbound_no AND bi.branch_code = po.branch_code
WHERE po.status = 'DELIVERED' AND po.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND bi.inbound_id IS NULL
ORDER BY po.po_id DESC

SELECT ho.hq_outbound_no AS hqOutboundNo, po.branch_code AS branchCode FROM place_order po
JOIN hq_outbound ho ON ho.po_no = po.po_no AND ho.branch_code = po.branch_code
LEFT JOIN branch_stock_inbound bi ON bi.hq_outbound_no = ho.hq_outbound_no AND bi.branch_code = po.branch_code
WHERE po.po_no = #{poNo} AND po.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND po.status = 'DELIVERED' AND bi.inbound_id IS NULL
LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO branch_stock_inbound ( hq_outbound_no, branch_code, received_at ) VALUES ( #{hqOutboundNo}, #{branchCode}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT hod.hq_outbound_detail_id AS hqOutboundDetailId, hod.qty AS outboundQty,
ws.stock_no AS stockNo, ws.material_code AS materialCode, DATE_FORMAT(ws.expiry_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expiryDate
FROM hq_outbound_detail hod
JOIN hq_outbound ho ON ho.hq_outbound_no = hod.hq_outbound_no
JOIN warehouse_stock ws ON ws.stock_no = hod.stock_no
WHERE hod.hq_outbound_detail_id = #{hqOutboundDetailId} AND ho.hq_outbound_no = #{hqOutboundNo}
LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO branch_stock_inbound_detail ( inbound_id, hq_outbound_detail_id, qty, branch_stock_code ) VALUES ( #{inboundId}, #{hqOutboundDetailId}, #{qty}, #{branchStockCode} )
INSERT INTO branch_stock ( branch_code, material_code, expire_date, received_at, current_qty ) VALUES ( #{branchCode}, #{materialCode}, #{expiryDate}, NOW(), #{receivedQty} )

INSERT INTO branch_stock_change_history ( branch_stock_code, change_amount, change_type, after_qty, changed_at ) SELECT bs.branch_stock_code, #{qty}, 'INBOUND', bs.current_qty, NOW() FROM branch_stock bs WHERE bs.branch_stock_code = #{branchStockCode}
